{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_163")
import kernel
dev = "cuda"
def exact_dft(x):
    # x: [B,N] float64 -> [B,N//2+1,2] high precision
    N = x.shape[1]
    j = torch.arange(N, dtype=torch.float64, device=x.device)
    k = torch.arange(N//2+1, dtype=torch.float64, device=x.device)
    ang = -2j * torch.pi * torch.outer(k, j) / N
    M = torch.exp(ang)  # [K,N]
    X = x @ M.T.conj().conj().T  # x [B,N] @ exp matrix [N,K]
    return torch.stack((X.real, X.imag), dim=-1)

res = {"per_N": {}}
overall_ok = True
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    rows = []
    B = 4
    x = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    # impulse at different positions
    for b in range(B):
        x[b, b*7 % N] = 1.0
    rows.append(x)
    # adversarial spectra: single-bin complex sinusoid rows
    xs = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    for b in range(B):
        j = torch.arange(N, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64)
        freq = (b*3+1)
        xs[b] = torch.cos(2*torch.pi*freq*j/N + b).to(torch.float16)
    rows.append(xs)
    # Nyquist / DC / alternating
    xn = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    xn[0] = 1.0; xn[1] = -1.0; xn[2,:] = (torch.arange(N,device=dev,dtype=torch.float16)%2*2-1)
    rows.append(xn)
    # random
    rows.append(torch.randn(B, N, device=dev, dtype=torch.float16))
    worst = 0.0; worst_rel_ok = True; bad = 0; worst_info = None
    for ti, x in enumerate(rows):
        out = kernel.run(x)
        ex = exact_dft(x.to(torch.float64))
        err = (out.double() - ex).abs()
        tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6*ex.abs()
        viol = (err > tol)
        if viol.any():
            bad += int(viol.sum())
            idx = (err - tol).argmax()
            worst_info = {"test": ti, "idx": idx.item(), "err": err.flatten()[idx].item(), "tol": tol.flatten()[idx].item()}
        r = (err / (tol)).max().item()
        worst = max(worst, r)
    res["per_N"][N] = {"worst_err_over_tol": worst, "violations": bad, "worst_case": worst_info}
    overall_ok = overall_ok and bad == 0
res["all_pass"] = overall_ok
print(res)", "expected_signal": "All N in {64,128,256} and impulse/adversarial spectra match exact DFT within tolerance"}

sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_163")
import kernel
dev = "cuda"
def exact_dft(x):
    N = x.shape[1]
    j = torch.arange(N, dtype=torch.float64, device=x.device)
    k = torch.arange(N//2+1, dtype=torch.float64, device=x.device)
    M = torch.exp(-2j * torch.pi * torch.outer(k, j) / N)
    X = x @ M.T
    return torch.stack((X.real, X.imag), dim=-1)

# verify cosine table literals at double precision
import math
tab_ok = True; tab_maxdiff = 0.0
from kernel import _COSINE
for i, v in enumerate(_COSINE):
    d = abs(v - math.cos(2*math.pi*i/256))
    tab_maxdiff = max(tab_maxdiff, d)
    tab_ok = tab_ok and d < 1e-17
res = {"table_maxdiff": tab_maxdiff, "table_ok": tab_ok, "cases": {}}
worst = 0.0; total_bad = 0
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    B = 6
    x = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    big = torch.finfo(torch.float16).max
    x[0,:] = big
    x[1,:] = -big
    x[2,:] = big if N % 2 == 0 else 0
    x[2,:] = torch.where(torch.arange(N,device=dev)%2==0, torch.tensor(big,device=dev), torch.tensor(-big,device=dev))
    x[3,:] = torch.linspace(big, 1.0, N, device=dev).to(torch.float16)
    x[4] = (torch.randn(N, device=dev) * 20000).to(torch.float16)
    x[5,:] = 6e-8  # subnormal-ish small values (fp16 subnormal min ~6e-8)
    x[5,:] = 5.96e-8
    out = kernel.run(x)
    ex = exact_dft(x.to(torch.float64))
    err = (out.double() - ex).abs()
    tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6*ex.abs()
    viol = int((err > tol).sum())
    ratio = (err/tol).max().item()
    fin = bool(torch.isfinite(out).all())
    res["cases"][N] = {"violations": viol, "worst_err_over_tol": ratio, "finite": fin, "max_exact_mag": ex.abs().max().item()}
    total_bad += viol
    worst = max(worst, ratio)
res["all_pass"] = total_bad == 0
res["worst_ratio"] = worst
print(res)", "expected_signal": "Extreme FP16 rows stay within 1e-4+1e-6*|exact| of the exact DFT and are finite; table literals are true doubles"}
